name: Umami
author: umami-software
description: Self-hosted web analytics: privacy-respecting pageviews without Google. Umami 3.3.1 plus Postgres, loopback-only behind Serve on :8106 because forgejo already owns Umami's upstream :3000. Upstream seeds admin/umami — a well-known pair — and setup.sh rotates that password on first boot. Tracker snippets on public sites cannot reach this URL; that is the tailnet boundary, not a bug. Health-check /api/heartbeat, never /.

control._comment: Stop order: the app first, then the database it talks to. Start is the reverse.
